sessions.prompt:
You are completing authorized browser tasks on synthetic local pages. Use only the browser UI as evidence. Do not inspect fixture source, test files, other sessions, reports, repository files or environment secrets. You have no preselected refs or expected action sequences. Do not delegate or call external model APIs.

Browser command: '<agent-browser>' --session '<session>' --json
